syntheses.title: Use of Deep Neural Networks for Autonomous Vehicle Control
syntheses.body: Multiple studies employ deep neural networks to control autonomous vehicles. For example, a CNN learns the entire processing pipeline to steer a car (claim e66d15a0-9347-5814-b053-1ff1dea8058d), while ChauffeurNet uses an RNN to output driving trajectories from mid-level inputs (claim cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24). These models leverage advances in neural architectures and training methods, such as CNNs being more powerful than earlier fully-connected networks (claim dd51b232-3e92-5d5e-b0e7-b982c3ee1e65) and training with backpropagation (claim 7a55c35c-41b2-5ae6-a170-4aefe1f7ae2c).

syntheses.title: CARLA Simulator as a Platform for Autonomous Driving Research
syntheses.body: CARLA is widely used as an open-source urban driving simulator supporting development, training, and validation of autonomous driving systems (claims 6dde98eb-ff12-5785-926e-11fbb8cd299b, 2dedfe39-6dab-5024-be2e-997515e0211d, 1d021b0a-2ce3-5e4a-badb-de76d4cd2b41). It provides extensive digital assets including urban layouts, vehicles, and pedestrians (claims 0488bcfc-4a7e-5848-a1d4-1e81239f8f55, fe6967d3-e559-5d60-811b-65a206438009), flexible sensor suite specifications (claim b26241aa-3d3d-560b-9a47-d8c65f50bfa3), and supports multiple sensing modalities and traffic rule compliance measurements (claims 11db4da2-416e-5320-bf67-dd823e2ddaa8, a4766e4b-52af-520a-b0f2-2c0267bf443f). CARLA enables evaluation of different autonomous driving approaches in controlled scenarios (claims 7e8db57a-25dd-55f8-9220-c289a62aea7f, a4f1d6b1-8d70-5572-a296-1d5aeacfd7d0).

syntheses.title: Challenges and Limitations of Imitation Learning in Autonomous Driving
syntheses.body: Findings indicate that pure imitation learning approaches, even with large datasets and mid-level input/output representations, are insufficient for robust autonomous driving (claims 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf, 09081b52-e1ad-5843-9bbc-8565cf5aea59). Limitations include error accumulation and distribution shift when running closed-loop simulations (claim c9759883-dd81-58a9-ab2d-155a512245df), and occasional failures such as getting stuck or colliding with parked vehicles despite available maneuvers (claim cf5a09ec-bfde-5049-ac07-ec7d2e843d78).

syntheses.title: Historical Foundations and Data Collection for Autonomous Driving Models
syntheses.body: The development of autonomous driving models builds upon earlier projects such as the DARPA Autonomous Vehicle (DAVE) project and the ALVINN system from 1989 (claims 921c6021-1bc9-5882-bed7-218fbe19322d, 443f6210-6468-59f8-8167-b719d39fc8fd). Data collection for training includes diverse roads, lighting, and weather conditions, using vehicles equipped with cameras (claims 70eb8202-ac82-55fb-a95a-efb095234403, 1afead50-3221-58ef-9912-38613577c16d). Drivers were instructed to drive normally and attentively during data collection (claim 34d85362-1ab7-5462-ac7c-f2c84434250b).
